title: nan
authors: Queralta J.P.; Li Q.; Schiano F.; Westerlund T.
key_contribution: Presents a VIO-UWB collaborative localization approach for dense scene reconstruction in heterogeneous ground-robot and MAV systems in GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulation and real experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
